material.acceptance_criteria: At 1280x720 the top strip shows only the two team kill counts and the game clock, no per-hero dots and no gold; the Tab scoreboard keeps per-seat kills, deaths, assists and gold; node --check passes on each JS file changed; ci-status is green for the publishing sha.
material.description: The top-centre team strip, built in scenarios/moba/panels.lua (strip around lines 279-300, emitted at line 798), shows each side's kills, one dot per hero and the gold of each seat. The reference (Dota) top-centre bar shows only the two team kill counts and the game clock. The per-hero dots and per-seat gold already live on the Tab scoreboard (scoreboard_tree, panels.lua:557-586) and belong there only. The strip must shrink to Dota's format and its text labels must come from moba_ui.json.
material.resolution: Top strip cut to Dota's two kill counts and the clock (22fc7e2d); scoreboard keeps per-seat rows.
material.subject: Top team strip is too large: cut it to Dota's two kill counts and the clock
material.witness: Live Pages, https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html at 1280x720 (origin tip 7f68d3bc). Top-centre strip shows only 'kills 0 | pre-match | kills 0' (two team kill counts and the clock), no per-hero dots, no gold; screenshot .gm/witness/hud-team-strip-1280x720.png, dispatch 1792894890599-5219-74765a958d9b2abd. Tab scoreboard (dispatch 1792894937942-5228-91dc9e31d20faaf5, .gm/witness/hud-scoreboard-tab-1280x720.png) keeps per-seat rows P0-P9 with K, D, A and gold. Publish sha 22fc7e2d: ci-status success on all 6 jobs (run 40111616682, dispatch 1792894606523-5059-4e558640e8872fdc). The commit touches no JS, so node --check does not apply.
material.witness_plan: Capture an in-game screenshot at 1280x720 through the gm browser verbs (cdp, one window, separate SESSION_ID from the resolver) and compare with the Dota reference: the strip holds two counts and a clock only. Also capture the Tab scoreboard and confirm its rows are unchanged.
